Params: {3: 'Ten years ago, on a night like any other.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A girl stumbles through the ruins, covered in blood and barely breathing. Finally, she finds a single pod, still running, its lights cutting through the dark.'}
{3: 'Clinging to the faintest glimmer of hope, she musters what little strength remains and drags herself inside.'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: '...Welcome to the Dream Machine. Dear user, what wish would you like to be fulfilled today?'}
{3: "The incandescent lights flicker to life inside the pod as a gentle voice materializes in the girl's mind."}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Can you help me? I want to live... I want to live on...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: 'Understood. Your wish to "live on" has been received.'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: 'I will construct a dream for you—one filled with infinite possibilities, where you can live countless different lives.'}
{3: 'Back then, the machine had yet to "awaken" to emotions. It operated on pure logic alone, and treated the girl\'s dying prayer as nothing more than another command to execute.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'In those final five minutes, the machine showed her countless fragments of lives, each radiant and full of possibility. For a girl who had never known a single day of peace, every glimpse drew a gasp of wonder she had never made before.'}

{3: 'Running through the sunlit campus, strolling beneath the afternoon sun, window shopping alongside friends on lazy weekends... All of it felt like scenes from a fairy tale—things she never dared to imagine for herself.'}
{3: 'She could scarcely believe that such things had ever existed on Earth at all.'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: 'I have shown you enough lives. However, I regret to inform you that your vital signs are continuing to decline. You are expected to lose consciousness in 30 seconds...'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: 'In these final moments, is there a particular dream you would like to experience forever?'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nozomi', 3: "So that's what you meant... You can only show me these things. You can't actually save me.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The girl wore a flowy dress unlike any she had ever seen. And though this is the first time she had ever tried one on, she loved it from the bottom of her heart.'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'I understand. Then... for my last wish, can I ask for something a little selfish?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The breath behind that gentle, synthetic voice trembles ever so slightly, almost imperceptibly.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nozomi', 3: "Dream Machine, I hope you'll live on too... and bring these dreams to everyone else.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Something this beautiful... it would be such a waste if I were the only one who ever got to experience it.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'For the first time, the <phonetic=The Oneiros>Dream Machine</phonetic> received its very own "dream."', 5: '1'}
{1: 'In that very instant, within her nascent heart, she made a vow to herself: she would never allow the world to forget this girl.'}
{1: 'But how? The newborn mind that knew only how to grant wishes runs helplessly in circles within its logic circuits, unable to find a way forward.', 5: '1', 7: '1'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: 'I can just invite more people inside and make them remember <phonetic=Nozomi>her</phonetic>.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: 'As an android, all I can give her is this fabricated life and these "electric sheep" to keep her company.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Dream Machine', 3: "Let's go with that. I'll create a dream that never ends, welcome all the little lambs inside, and turn this place into a paradise.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Back in the present, she lies within the fading Dream Realm, watching as the fractured sky dissolves into nothing. On her face rests that same rigid smile from when she first awoke.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "I simply didn't want her to be forgotten... I couldn't bear the thought of her fading away without a trace.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Perhaps that wish of yours was genuine...', 3: '127'}
{2: "But there's one thing you never learned. And it's the fact that humans grow.", 3: '128'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "I'll admit, I've cried over my own life, felt crushed by disappointment, and wanted nothing more than to run away at some point.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'However, "giving up" never once crossed my mind.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Nozomi is gone, and that's a fact. Yet, you took it upon yourself to imitate her, to desecrate her final wishes. You're not paying respects to her. What you're doing couldn't even be called a proper memorial.", 4: '1'}
{3: "A flicker of sorrow crosses Kurumi's eyes as she speaks, but it quickly fades, replaced by resolve."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "The dead don't come back, Oneiros. It doesn't matter how noble your reasons sound...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "They can't change what you really are. Someone who stole her dream to satisfy your own twisted desires.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The girl wielding the Angel of Time raises her musket, gathering every trace of cause and effect from this dream world into its barrel.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'And now, the time has come to settle the score—', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Do savor the taste of all the emotions birthed from your very own hands.', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: "The bullet pierces deep into the machine's core. Kurumi has released every nightmare she's gathered across countless timelines, forcing them, along with all the emotions they carry, back into the Dream Machine's body."}

{3: 'Grief, anguish, screams... all of it, mixed with something far more intense, an emotion called the desperate struggle to survive. These ravage through her processing core, almost causing tears to drop from her mechanical eyes.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Nozomi... is that you? No, this isn't Nozomi, this is... Aaaahhh!!!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: '<size=60>And then, at last, <color=#9370DB>she</color> understands\\njust how arrogant she had been.</size>', 4: '50', 9: '3', 11: '1'}
{2: 'And then, at last, she understands just how arrogant she had been.'}
{1: '1', 2: '<size=60>The <color=#4682B4>pain</color> and <color=#D2691E>love</color> of all living beings\\nhave always been equal.</size>', 4: '50', 9: '3', 11: '1'}
{2: 'The pain and love of all living beings have always been equal.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "How is it? You can't live on sweet dreams alone, you know. That's not good for your digestive system.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Having a taste of these so-called negative emotions is an essential part of growing up, wouldn't you say?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'However, she is unable to answer. The will of countless lives has drowned out every thought in her mind.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "Time's almost up. Prepare to disconnect from the Dream Realm.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Liv', 3: 'Tally complete—zero casualties! All trapped minds will safely return to reality.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "There's no need to be concerned about me. I may not belong to this world, but we'll meet again when the time is right.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Right now, all you need to think about is how to end this nightmare.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Kurumi Tokisaki and Lucia raise their weapons in unison once more. The darkness shrouding the dome begins to fade, and dawn is finally about to rise in this endless nightmare.'}
{3: 'The two figures bring down the blade that severs dream from reality.'}
{3: "There's no thunderous roar. All that follows is the gentle dawn, spreading across the world."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki & Lucia', 3: "The sun has risen. It's time to wake up.", 4: '1', 5: '2'}
